status: analytic lumped/transmission-line model, not EM; connector L/C estimated (no HF data published)

sources.connector: HCTL HC-PBB40C-70DP-0.4V-02, https://www.lcsc.com/product-detail/C19089236.html (mate C19089262); 0.4 mm pitch, 2 x 35, 0.3 A/contact, stack 1.5-4 mm; no SI data

board.stackup: F.Cu 17.5um / 0.196 prepreg FR4 er4.5 tand0.02 / In1 GND / 0.23 core / In2 GND / 0.196 prepreg / B.Cu; total 0.747 mm
board.gnd: one net; solid In1/In2; F.Cu pour excluded inside the finger ring (keepout 9.4x10.2 mm); B.Cu pour
board.die_paddle: pad 75: 4.0 x 5.2 mm GND, 6 x 0.3 mm drill vias to GND
board.fingers: 1.0 x 0.25 mm, 0.4 mm pitch; N/S rows at +-4.7 mm, E/W at +-4.3 mm from centre
board.connector_side: B.Cu, centred under the die; GND contacts 10,18,25,45,53,61 + 4 MP shell tabs
board.passives: 8 x 0201 footprints (C101-C108, labelled 1 uF) on B.Cu edge strips (x = +-6.25 mm), each supply-net to GND; NO footprint on any signal net
board.pads_74_vs_contacts_70: 56 signal + 8 supply sites each own one contact; the 10 die GND bonds share the GND plane (6 contacts + 4 tabs). No functional signal loses a path.

placement_sweep.definition: strip = COB passive strip (shunt-only rework, back-side edge); conn+2mm = carrier just past the connector; car10/30/50mm = 50-ohm carrier line

host_ssn.stagger_2groups: halves bounce for the same edge rate

thermal.paddle_vias: 6 x 0.3 mm drill (0.5 mm pad), GND
thermal.back_side: mezzanine connector U101 occupies the area under the die (B.Cu, centred on the die) -> no plate/coin contact
